correctness.rationale: The symbolic proof checks out. For composite \(n\) with least prime divisor \(p\), \(\Delta=R+T\) where the alternating tail \(R\ge1\) and \(T=n(1-1/p)-\varphi(n)\ge0\). For prime powers, direct summation gives \(\Delta(p^a)=(p^{a-1}+(-1)^a)/(p+1)\), isolating all gap-one and gap-two cases. With at least two distinct prime factors and second-smallest prime \(q\), \(T\ge n(p-1)/(pq)\ge p-1\), hence \(\Delta\ge p\); gap two forces \(p=2\), \(R=T=1\), and then \(n=2q\). Fresh independent computation through 20,000 exactly matched all three fibers and served only as regression evidence.
risks: Only the fibers 0, 1 and 2 are classified; no pattern for higher fixed gaps is claimed.
sources: Fresh symbolic reconstruction and independent finite regression through 20,000
